## Planning status

This is the working instructional map, not yet a published commitment. Lecture titles, the midterm date, and assessment coverage remain tentative.
:::

## Calendar basis

The macOS Calendar event `MAT E 374 LEC A1` is scheduled **Monday, Wednesday, and Friday, 12:00–12:50 p.m. in NRE 2-090**, beginning Wednesday, September 2, 2026. Its recurrence ends with the final Monday meeting on December 7.

The [University of Alberta Calendar 2026–2027](https://calendar.ualberta.ca/content.php?catoid=69&navoid=20884) identifies the following interruptions:

- Monday, September 7 — Labour Day;
- Wednesday, September 30 — National Day for Truth and Reconciliation;
- Monday, October 12 — Thanksgiving Day;
- Monday–Friday, November 9–13 — Fall Reading Week, including Remembrance Day on Wednesday, November 11.

The University’s last day of Fall Term classes is Tuesday, December 8. Because this section meets MWF, its final scheduled class is Monday, December 7.

## Meeting count

| Item | Count |
|---|---:|
| MWF timetable slots, September 2–December 7 | 42 |
| Slots removed by holidays and Reading Week | 6 |
| Available in-person meetings | **36** |
| Tentative in-class midterm | 1 |
| Instructional lecture meetings | **35** |

This fits the proposed L01–L35 course map exactly if one regular meeting is reserved for the midterm.

## Midterm rationale

Wednesday, October 28 is a useful provisional boundary because Unit 4 ends on the preceding Monday. It leaves one complete meeting for the midterm without reducing the 35 planned instructional lectures. The intended coverage would be Units 1–4; Orientation would supply practices and context rather than a separate content block.
